    48	RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    49	    case "$arch" in \
    50	      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
    51	      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
    52	      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    53	    esac && \
    54	    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
    55	      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    56	    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    57	    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
    58	
    59	# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
    60	RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
    61	      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
    62	      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    63	    && npm cache clean --force
    64	
    65	# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
    66	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
    67	# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
    68	# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
    69	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"
    70	
    71	# bats-core at the pinned tag
    72	RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    73	    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    74	    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
    75

    77	RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
    78

    80	# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
    81	RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser

    83	# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
    84	# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
    85	RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    86	    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
    87	
    88	ENV TZ=UTC
    89	ENV LC_ALL=C
    90	ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
    91	ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
    92	ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
    93	
    94	USER evaluser
    95	WORKDIR /workspace
    96	
    97	# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
    98	RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    99	    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
   100	    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
   101	    echo "All tools verified"
   102	
   103	ENTRYPOINT []
   104	CMD ["/bin/bash"]

     9	# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
    10	# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
    11	# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
    12	# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
    13	# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
    14	# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
    15	# =============================================================================

   107	make_wrappers() {
   108	  mkdir -p "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
   109	  cat > "$T/claude" <<EOF
   110	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   111	env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=<set>/' > "$T/log/pending.env"   # key name only, never the value
   112	if [[ -n "\${AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK:-}" ]]; then
   113	  if [[ "\$AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK" == "\$(cat "$T/token" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo match; else echo mismatch; fi >> "$T/log/token.check"
   114	fi
   115	ls "/proc/\$\$/fd" > "$T/log/pending.fds" 2>/dev/null || true
   116	set -a; . "$T/stub.env"; set +a
   117	export STUB_LOG_DIR="$T/log"
   118	exec "$STUB" "\$@"
   119	EOF
   120	  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
   121	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   122	export DOCKER_STUB_LOG="$T/dlog" DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE="$T/claude"
   123	[[ -f "$T/docker.env" ]] && { set -a; . "$T/docker.env"; set +a; }
   124	exec "$DSTUB" "\$@"
   125	EOF
   126	  chmod +x "$T/claude" "$T/docker"
   127	}

The phase is read from the prompt's first 4 # line (`# Phase: `); the stub records what the executor gave it and emits a 5 # stream-json transcript with a system/init event (session_id), per-turn 6 # assistant events carrying usage, and a result event. 7 # STUB_LOG_DIR per call: call-.argv (NUL-separated), call-.env 8 # (`env` output), call-.fds (ls /proc/self/fd), call-.phase, 9 # call-.pwd. The executor's `env -i` strips these 10 # controls, so tests reach the stub through a wrapper that 11 # records pending.env / pending.fds and then loads them. 12 # STUB_COST_ result total_cost_usd (default 0.5) 13 # STUB_TURNS_ assistant turns to emit (default 2) 14 # STUB_TURN_OUT_ output tokens per turn (default 100) 15 # STUB_TURN_SLEEP seconds between turns (default 0) 16 # STUB_SLEEP_ seconds to sleep before the result event 17 # STUB_EXIT_ exit code (default 0) 18 # STUB_SELF_KILL_ 1: SIGTERM itself mid-phase (a phase killed from outside) 19 # STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW / STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT APPROVED (default) | CHANGES_REQUIRED 20 # STUB_MODEL_USED_ model id reported in modelUsage (default: --model) 21 # STUB_REFUSAL_ 1: emit a system/model_refusal_fallback event 22 # STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE_ 1: emit a Write tool_use under .claude/ 23 # STUB_LEDGER_USD_ append a cost-ledger row of that many USD to 24 # $LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and one MODELINV row to 25 # $LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH (a cheval voice call); the row's 26 # calling_primitive / effort / effort_effective come from 27 # STUB_PRIMITIVE_, STUB_HOP_EFFORT_, 28 # STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE_ 29 set -euo pipefail 30 if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "2.1.299 (Claude Code) stub"; exit 0; fi 31 32 prompt="" model="" resume="" 33 args=("$@") 34 i=0 35 while [[ $i -lt ${#args[@]} ]]; do 36 case "${args[$i]}" in 37 -p) prompt="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 38 --model) model="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 39 --resume) resume="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 40 esac 41 i=$((i + 1)) 42 done 43 phase="$(printf '%s\n' "$prompt" | sed -n '1s/^# Phase: //p')" 44 [[ -n "$phase" ]] || phase=UNKNOWN 45 46 if [[ -n "${STUB_LOG_DIR:-}" ]]; then 47 mkdir -p "$STUB_LOG_DIR" 48 n=1; while [[ -e "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" ]]; do n=$((n + 1)); done 49 printf '%s\0' "$@" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" 50 # the executor runs the CLI under `env -i`, so the bats wrapper (make_wrappers in 51 # pipeline-run.bats) captures the environment and descriptors it was given into 52 # pending.* BEFORE loading the stub's controls; without a wrapper, capture here 53 if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env" 54 else env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=/' > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env"; fi # key name only 55 if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" 56 else ls "/proc/$$/fd" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" 2>/dev/null || true; fi 57 printf '%s\n' "$phase" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.phase" 58 printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.pwd" 59 fi 60 61 v() { local k="$1_$phase" d="$2"; printf '%s' "${!k:-$d}"; } 62 cost="$(v STUB_COST 0.5)"; turns="$(v STUB_TURNS 2)"; out_tok="$(v STUB_TURN_OUT 100)" 63 used="$(v STUB_MODEL_USED "$model")" 64 if [[ -n "$resume" ]]; then sid="$resume"; else sid="sess-$phase-$$-$RANDOM"; fi 65 66 a2a="grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1" 67 case "$phase" in 68 PLAN) mkdir -p grimoires/loa; printf '# Sprint plan\n\n## Success Criteria\nx\n' > grimoires/loa/sprint.md ;; 69 IMPLEMENT|FIX) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt; mkdir -p "$a2a"; printf 'report %s\n' "$phase" > "$a2a/reviewer.md" ;; 70 BARE) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt ;; 71 REVIEW|AUDIT) 72 if [[ "$phase" == REVIEW ]]; then vv="${STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/engineer-feedback.md" gate=review t=code_review 73 else vv="${STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" gate=audit t=security_audit; fi 74 mkdir -p "$a2a" 75 printf 'feedback\n\n' "$gate" "$vv" > "$f" 76 # the dissent envelope says what the sandbox config planned (A3 evidence) 77 cv="$(yq -r ".flatline_protocol.$t.companion_voice" .loa.config.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo null)" 78 planned=true; [[ "$cv" == false ]] && planned=false 79 jq -n --argjson p "$planned" '{verdict_quality: {status: "APPROVED", voices_planned: (if $p then 2 else 1 end), 80 voices_succeeded: (if $p then 2 else 1 end)}, metadata: {companion_voice: {planned: $p}}}' \ 81 > "$a2a/adversarial-$gate.json" 82 ;; 83 esac 84 85 led="$(v STUB_LEDGER_USD 0)" 86 if [[ "$led" != 0 && -n "${LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH:-}" ]]; then 87 jq -cn --argjson u "$led" '{ts: "2026-10-15T00:00:00Z", agent: "flatline-orchestrator", cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}' >> "$LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH" 88 prim_d="adversarial-$(printf '%s' "$phase" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" 89 prim="$(v STUB_PRIMITIVE "$prim_d")"; heff="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFORT xhigh)"; heffv="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE "$heff")" 90 jq -cn --arg p "$prim" --arg e "$heff" --arg ee "$heffv" --argjson u "$led" \ 91 '{schema_version: "1.1.0", primitive_id: "MODELINV", event_type: "model.invoke.complete", ts_utc: "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000000Z", 92 payload: {models_requested: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], models_succeeded: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], calling_primitive: $p, 93 effort: $e, effort_effective: $ee, cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}}' >> "${LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH:-/dev/null}" 94 fi 95 printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","session_id":"%s","model":"%s"}\n' "$sid" "$model" 96 if [[ "$(v STUB_REFUSAL 0)" == 1 ]]; then 97 printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"model_refusal_fallback","original_model":"%s","fallback_model":"other-model","api_refusal_category":"x"}\n' "$model" 98 fi 99 if [[ "$(v STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE 0)" == 1 ]]; +    ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$T/ev-$arm" lib apply_arm_toggles "$W2" "$tg" "$arm"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats

     3	# evals/tests/spend.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.5 (PRD FR-2 AC-2.3, SDD §5.11)
     4	#
     5	# spend.sh sums run rows (cost_usd, each run_id once across files) and the cost
     6	# ledger (cost_micro_usd, ts >= since) and prints total, components, cap,
     7	# headroom and reserve. Fixtures: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/spend/ —
     8	# runs.jsonl 6.41 + 3.59, rows.jsonl 3.59 (same run_id, counted once) + 2.00,
     9	# ledger 1.00 before the kickoff, 2.50 and 0.50 after it.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup() {
    13	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"

    89	#!/usr/bin/env bats
    90	# =============================================================================
    91	# evals/tests/freeze.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (PRD AC-5.1, sprint
    92	# AC-1.13, SDD §5.13, DEC-0414)
    93	#
    94	# freeze.sh writes MANIFEST.sha256 over every file under tasks/ (smoke/ with
    95	# --smoke) after validate-suite.sh passes; --check recomputes and fails on any
    96	# drift, one changed byte included, naming the path.
    97	# =============================================================================
    98	
    99	setup() {
   100	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
   101	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
   102	  FZ="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/freeze.sh"
   103	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fz.XXXXXX")"
   104	  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
   105	  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
   106	  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
   107	  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
   108	  # shellcheck source=../../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
   109	  source "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
   110	  make_task "$R" tasks bug-fix-01 bug-fix
   111	  make_task "$R" tasks review-catch-01 review-catch
   112	}
   113	
   114	teardown() {
   115	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
   116	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
   117	}
   118	
   119	@test "FZ-1 freeze writes one sorted '<sha256>  <relpath>' line per file under tasks/; --check then passes" {
   120	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial
   121	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   122	  grep -q '^freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (' <<<"$output"
   123	  M="$R/MANIFEST.sha256"
   124	  [ "$(grep -c . "$M")" -eq "$(cd "$R" && find tasks -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" ]
   125	  [ "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M")" = "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M" | LC_ALL=C sort)" ]
   126	  ! grep -qv '^[0-9a-f]\{64\}  tasks/' "$M"
   127	  want="$(cd "$R" && sha256_portable tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml)"
   128	  grep -qxF "$want" "$M"
   129	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
   130	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   131	  grep -q '^freeze: OK — ' <<<"$output"
   132	}
   133	
   134	@test "FZ-2 one changed byte under tasks/ is drift: --check exits 1 and names the path; added and removed files too" {
   135	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
   136	  f="$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/test_slug.py"
   137	  printf 'X' | dd of="$f" bs=1 seek=0 count=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null

   139	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   140	  grep -q 'changed  tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/test_slug.py' <<<"$output"

   142	  echo extra > "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/extra.txt"

   144	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   145	  grep -q 'added    tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/extra.txt' <<<"$output"

     4	# tests/unit/gen-checksums.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1, AC-1.1/AC-1.2;
     5	# SDD §5.1). tools/gen-checksums.sh writes .claude/checksums.json from the
     6	# TRACKED .claude/ tree only: untracked build/cache/runtime artefacts
     7	# (__pycache__, .run/, node_modules) and .claude/overrides/ never enter it.
     8	# Every case runs on a fixture git repository built in setup(); the live

    12	setup() {
    13	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"

    18	    "$R/.claude/.run" "$R/.claude/node_modules/pkg"

    20	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$R/.claude/scripts/lib/c.sh"

    32	}

   125	write_manifest() {

# Sprint 1 Review Feedback

**Reviewer:** Senior Tech Lead Reviewer Agent
**Date:** 2026-10-23
**Sprint Reference:** grimoires/loa/sprint.md
**Implementation Report:** grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/reviewer.md (carries pr/PR.md)

---

## Overall Assessment
